items.statement: Let E be a finite-dimensional real Hilbert Borel space with canonical volume, including rank zero. Let V:E→ℝ be C2, 0<α≤β, α‖a‖²≤D²V(x)[a,a]≤β‖a‖² for every x,a, η>0 and βη≤1. Define μ=volume.tilted(−V), J=law(X,X+√ηZ) for independent X∼μ,Z∼N(0,I), and ν=J.snd. Then ν is a probability. There exists one densely defined closable real linear gradient G:L²(ν)⇀L²(ν;E), whose graph consists exactly of AE classes (φ,∇φ) for smooth compactly supported φ, and whose closure has closed graph. For every z in domḠ with ∫z dν=0, [α/(1+αη)]‖z‖²≤‖Ḡz‖². The same G is chosen before every such z. No caller normalization, curvature, Poincare, law, domain, convergence or extra moment certificate is assumed. This is the genuine compact-gradient closure formulation of the source marginal PI; equivalence with a separately defined weighted H1 remains open.
assumptions: Finite real Hilbert/Borel E with canonical volume, including rank0 explicit source extension.
V C2,0<α≤β and both global Hessian bounds;η>0 andβη≤1. The cap is retained although standalone PI needs less; actual sharp source consumer uses it.
Uniform genuine G before all centered z in its closed domain. Centering restricts the PI conclusion; no supplied operator/domain/law/PI or extra moment certificate.
Ḡ is exactly the closed smooth-compact gradient. Separately defined source weakH1 and onto macro range equivalences are not inferred.
